channel.title: Honolulu Civil Beat - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Honolulu Civil Beat (civilbeat.org)

item.title: Makana Eyre: We Deserve To Know Who’s Challenging Kamehameha Schools’ Policy
item.description: It seems only fair that the process should unfold with full transparency.

item.title: Could The Feds Help Hawaiʻi Develop Geothermal?
item.description: There are risks, but viable resources exist across the state, including on Oʻahu.

item.title: Inspectors Let ‘Lightly Infested’ Goods Into State. Lawmakers Want It To End
item.description: Sen. Jarrett Keohokalole is probing the department for evidence of what he believes to be a 'shadow policy' of favoring industries the Department of Agriculture and Biosecurity is in charge of regulating.

item.title: Aloha By Zippy’s Stadium? Oʻahu Venue Naming Rights Could Be At Play
item.description: To raise revenue for its redevelopment, officials of the Hālawa arena want to join the legions of mainland sports venues named for corporate sponsors.

item.title: Word Row: March 3
item.description: Five letters. Six chances. A whole lot of fun.

item.title: Hawaiʻi’ Should End Aquarium Collection Once And For All
item.description: Reef fish belong in the ocean, not in far-off fish tanks. Tell your elected officials.

item.title: The Stakes Have Never Been Higher For Maui Planning Department
item.description: The third Maui County planning director in three years plans to prioritize post-wildfire rebuilding and tackle complex local issues.

item.title: Time To Close The Campaign-To-Campaign Giving Loophole
item.description: The people of Hawaiʻi deserve to know where campaign money actually comes from, and where it goes.

item.title: Embezzler Or Victim? Native Hawaiian Contractor’s Family Fights Back
item.description: In various court filings, Christopher Dawson's sister is pushing back against the DOJ narrative that he swindled a federal program meant to help his people.

item.title: ‘Tough Times’: Honolulu Mayor Wants To Cut $50 Million For Vacant Jobs
item.description: After years of budget increases as the city emerged from the pandemic, this year the mayor proposed a lower budget than last year’s.
